Fields.Name: Back Home Time on Touching Enemy Wall
Fields.Description: When the NPC hits an enemy wall (a boundary that blocks enemies), the common AI scripts make it return home for this many seconds. 0: no reaction.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Forget Time
Fields.Description: Time to forget the visual target.

Fields.Name: Blocked Movement - Attack ID
Fields.Description: Animation that plays when the Npc cannot move passed on object

Fields.Name: Listen - Distance
Fields.Description: Hearing distance, if an AI sound is within the hearing radius the enemy will hear the sound

Fields.Name: Call Help - Reply Action ID
Fields.Description: Action played when responding

Fields.Name: Call Help - Call Action ID
Fields.Description: Action played when calling friends
Visual search range (normal)

Fields.Name: Guard action ID when returning home
Fields.Description: Action number to perform when looking at the target when returning home (intended for use in guarding, 0 disables)

Fields.Name: Listen - Sound Cutoff Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which to reduce the size of the sound source. Sounds below this distance will not be heard.

Fields.Name: Smell - Distance
Fields.Description: Npc will enter combat when an enemy is within this range

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Max Distance
Fields.Description: Metres from home (or its move point) beyond which the NPC stops fighting and goes home; with Back to Home Stuck Act 1 it walks back and fades to its start position. 9999: effectively never. A SpEffect can override it.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Distance
Fields.Description: Metres from home beyond which the NPC only keeps fighting targets within Retreat Home - Battle Distance; otherwise it returns or does its failed-path action. A SpEffect can override it.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Battle Distance
Fields.Description: Beyond Retreat Home - Distance, the NPC still fights a target closer than this many metres. A SpEffect can override it.

Fields.Name: Non-Battle Act Duration when in Combat
Fields.Description: Seconds of non-battle behaviour (going home) the common AI scripts run when the NPC gives up beyond Retreat Home - Max Distance.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Look for Target Time
Fields.Description: Seconds to keep watching the target while returning home. Available to scripts (GetExcelParam) but no Elden Ring script reads it; no other reader found.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Look for Target Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) within which the NPC watches the target while returning home. Available to scripts (GetExcelParam) and overridable by a SpEffect, but no Elden Ring script reads it.

Fields.Name: Listen - Search Forget Time
Fields.Description: Time to forget the sound target.

Fields.Name: Battle - Start Distance
Fields.Description: Combat start distance, must but within the vision cone

Fields.Name: Call Help - My Peer ID
Fields.Description: Your friend group id

Fields.Name: Call Help - Call Peer ID
Fields.Description: Companion group ID to call friends

Fields.Name: Target System - Damage Effect Rate
Fields.Description: Percentage of the damage taken from a character that counts toward choosing it as the target. 100: full; 0: damage doesn't affect targeting.

Fields.Name: Team Attack Effectivity
Fields.Description: A value for determining the number of simultaneous attackers in a team. Each enemy adds their value to a pool and when that value exceeds 100 Npc aggresion is reduced via AI

Fields.Name: Disable Darkness Modifier
Fields.Description: Sight and Battle start disatnce will not be affected by darkness?
Goal action: The target became alert due to the detection of the presence position.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Valid Target Min Distance
Fields.Description: If it's closer than this value, you can't call a friend.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Valid Target Range
Fields.Description: If the friend is farther than this value, it will not be called.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Forget Time by Arrival
Fields.Description: Time to respond

Fields.Name: Call Help - Min Wait Time
Fields.Description: Minimum time in the first waiting goal of the responding goal [101=>10.1sec]

Fields.Name: Call Help - Max Wait Time
Fields.Description: Maximum time in first waiting goal of responding goal [101=>10.1sec]

Fields.Name: Goal Action - To Caution (Sound)
Fields.Description: Goal Action: The target is alerted by normal sound detection.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - To Search (Sound)
Fields.Description: Goal Action: Target is spotted

Fields.Name: Call Help - Reply Behavior Type
Fields.Description: Action type to target position after response

Fields.Name: Disable Path Move
Fields.Description: Ignore navmesh, even if one is present?

Fields.Name: Skip Arrival Visibility Check
Fields.Description: Do you want to skip arrival determination by line of sight? When set to On, arrival judgment is performed even if the line of sight is not passing.

Fields.Name: Think Attribute - Do Admirer
Fields.Description: When on, the NPC takes part in surrounding the target (admirer role) instead of always attacking; read by many battle scripts through GetExcelParam and DoAdmirer_ThinkAttr.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Edge
Fields.Description: Meant to allow navmesh cliff edges.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Large Space
Fields.Description: Meant to allow wide-space navmesh.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Ladder
Fields.Description: When on, the NPC may path over ladders and periodically looks for ladders to use.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Hole
Fields.Description: Meant to allow navmesh holes.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Door
Fields.Description: Meant to allow navmesh doors.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Ignore Navmesh Wall
Fields.Description: Meant to allow navmesh inside walls.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Cliff Edge
Fields.Description: Meant to allow cliff edges outside battle.
